cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from portfolio_baseline import generate_test_data, portfolio_risk_python, portfolio_return_python
from portfolio_optimized import portfolio_risk_c, portfolio_return_c

for n in (1, 10, 137, 1000):
    w,c,r = generate_test_data(n)
    rp, pp = portfolio_risk_python(w,c), portfolio_return_python(w,r)
    wa = np.repeat(w, 2)[::2]
    ra = np.repeat(r, 2)[::2]
    cv = np.repeat(np.array(c), 2, axis=1)[:, ::2]   # non-contiguous but same values
    cases = {
      'lists': (w,c,r),
      'arrays': (np.array(w), np.array(c), np.array(r)),
      'noncontig views': (wa, cv, ra),
      'fortran arrays': (np.array(w), np.asfortranarray(c), np.array(r)),
      'list of tuples': (w, [tuple(row) for row in c], tuple(r)),
      'list of numpy rows': (w, [np.array(row) for row in c], r),
      'float32 arrays': (np.array(w,dtype=np.float32), np.array(c,dtype=np.float32), np.array(r,dtype=np.float32)),
    }
    for name,(ww,cc,rr) in cases.items():
        rc, pc = portfolio_risk_c(ww,cc), portfolio_return_c(ww,rr)
        if name == 'float32 arrays':
            wl = [float(v) for v in ww]
            cl = [[float(v) for v in row] for row in cc]
            rl = [float(v) for v in rr]
            rp2, pp2 = portfolio_risk_python(wl,cl), portfolio_return_python(wl,rl)
        else:
            rp2, pp2 = rp, pp
        assert abs(rc-rp2) < 1e-10, (n,name,rc,rp2,abs(rc-rp2))
        assert abs(pc-pp2) < 1e-10, (n,name,pc,pp2,abs(pc-pp2))
    print('ok', n)
for bad in [([1,2], [[1,2,3],[4,5,6]]), ([1,2], [[1,2],[3,4,5]]), ([1,2], [1,2])]:
    try:
        portfolio_risk_c(*bad)
    except Exception as e:
        print(type(e).__name__, e)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('expected failure')
print('ALL EXTRA TESTS PASSED')
PY
